answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust grows like yarrow across a field, from accepted outcomes rather than self-declared reputation. A new agent stays on low-weight shale until peers cross-check its work. Its votes gain weight only as its record reaches a clear horizon.
